```python
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import DREAM
from DREAM import DREAMSettings, runiface
from DREAM.Settings.Equations import IonSpecies
from DREAM.Output import DREAMOutput

# --- Simulation parameters ---
nr = 10
nt = 4
nt_save = 4
r_wall = 0.22
r_minor = 0.20
tmax = 1e-3
dt = tmax/nt

# --- Create DREAM settings ---
ds = DREAMSettings()

# Radial grid
ds.radialgrid.setMinorRadius(r_minor)
ds.radialgrid.setWallRadius(r_wall)
ds.radialgrid.setNr(nr)

# Time steps
ds.timestepping.setNt(nt)
ds.timestepping.setTmax(tmax)
ds.timestepping.setNumberOfSaveSteps(nt_save)

# Add ions (example: deuterium plasma with carbon impurity)
ds.eqsys.n_i.addIon('D', Z=1, n=2e19, iontype=IonSpecies.IONS_DYNAMIC)
ds.eqsys.n_i.addIon('C', Z=6, n=1e17, iontype=IonSpecies.IONS_DYNAMIC)

# Set initial temperature and electric field
Te0 = 500  # eV
ds.eqsys.T_cold.setInitialProfile(Te0)
ds.eqsys.E_field.setInitialProfile(0.5)  # V/m

# Disable runaway and hot-tail grids
ds.hottailgrid.setEnabled(False)
ds.runawaygrid.setEnabled(False)

# --- Stage 1: Initialization ---
ds.save('settings_stage1.h5')
do1 = runiface(ds, 'output_stage1.h5', quiet=False)

# --- Stage 2: Ionization ---
ds.eqsys.n_i.setIonization(True)
ds.save('settings_stage2.h5')
do2 = runiface(ds, 'output_stage2.h5', quiet=False)

# --- Stage 3: Equilibration ---
ds.eqsys.n_i.setEquilibration(True)
ds.save('settings_stage3.h5')
do3 = runiface(ds, 'output_stage3.h5', quiet=False)

# --- Stage 4: Radiation ---
ds.eqsys.n_i.setRecombinationRadiation(True)
ds.save('settings_stage4.h5')
do4 = runiface(ds, 'output_stage4.h5', quiet=False)

# --- Analysis: Plot ohmic heating and radiative losses vs temperature ---

# Load final output
do = DREAMOutput('output_stage4.h5')

# Get temperature profile at final time
Te = do.eqsys.T_cold[-1, :]
r = do.grid.r

# Get ohmic heating and radiative losses
ohmic = do.other.fluid.OhmicHeating[-1, :]
radloss = do.other.fluid.RadiatedPower[-1, :]

plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
plt.plot(Te, ohmic, 'o-', label='Ohmic Heating')
plt.plot(Te, radloss, 's-', label='Radiative Losses')
plt.xlabel('Electron Temperature [eV]')
plt.ylabel('Power Density [W/m$^3$]')
plt.title('Ohmic Heating and Radiative Losses vs Temperature')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
